---
title: "`r params$title`"
subtitle: "Bulk RNA-seq analysis report"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%Y-%m-%d')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: false
    number_sections: true
    self_contained: true
params:
  title: "Bulk RNA-seq analysis"
  results_dir: "results"
  config_file: "config.yaml"
  reference: "No_pCR"
  treatment: "pCR"
  alpha: 0.05
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
tab <- function(f) file.path(params$results_dir, "tables", f)
fig <- function(f) file.path(params$results_dir, "figures", "png", paste0(f, ".png"))
rd <- function(f) utils::read.delim(tab(f), check.names = FALSE, quote = "",
                                    comment.char = "", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
show_fig <- function(f) if (file.exists(fig(f))) knitr::include_graphics(fig(f), rel_path = FALSE) else
  cat("_Figure not available:", f, "_\n")
lab <- function(x) gsub("_", " ", x)
```

Configuration: `r params$config_file`. Contrast: **`r lab(params$treatment)` vs `r lab(params$reference)`**
(positive log2 fold change = higher in `r lab(params$treatment)`).

# Samples and filtering

```{r}
qc <- rd("sample_qc_metrics.tsv")
filt <- rd("gene_filtering_summary.tsv")
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(table(Condition = lab(qc$condition))), caption = "Samples per group")
knitr::kable(filt, caption = "Gene filter (>= min_count reads in >= min_samples samples)")
```

```{r, out.width = "90%"}
show_fig("Fig01_Sample_QC")
```

# Sample-level QC

```{r}
out <- rd("qc_outlier_flags.tsv")
n_out <- sum(out$outlier_flag)
```

`r n_out` sample(s) flagged as potential outliers (|z| of mean VST distance above threshold).
Flagged samples are retained in the analysis.

```{r, out.width = "90%"}
show_fig("Fig02_PCA")
show_fig("Fig03A_Sample_Distance")
```

# Differential expression

```{r}
res <- rd("DESeq2_results_all.tsv")
sig <- res[!is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < params$alpha, ]
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  `Genes tested` = nrow(res),
  `padj < alpha` = nrow(sig),
  `Higher in treatment` = sum(sig$log2FoldChange > 0),
  `Lower in treatment` = sum(sig$log2FoldChange < 0), check.names = FALSE),
  caption = sprintf("DESeq2 Wald test, BH-adjusted p < %.2g; log2FC shrunk with apeglm", params$alpha))
top <- head(res[, c("symbol", "gene_id", "baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "log2FoldChange_MLE", "padj")], 20)
knitr::kable(top, digits = 3, caption = "Top 20 genes by adjusted p-value")
```

```{r, out.width = "80%"}
show_fig("Fig04_Volcano")
show_fig("Fig05_MA_Plot")
show_fig("Fig07_Top_DE_Heatmap")
```

# Cell-type enrichment (xCell)

```{r, results = "asis"}
if (file.exists(tab("deconvolution_xcell_pcr_vs_nopcr.tsv"))) {
  xs <- rd("deconvolution_xcell_pcr_vs_nopcr.tsv")
  print(knitr::kable(head(xs, 15), digits = 3,
                     caption = "Wilcoxon rank-sum test per cell type (BH-adjusted)"))
} else cat("xCell was not run.\n")
```

```{r, out.width = "80%"}
show_fig("Fig09C_Significant_CellTypes")
```

# Pathway enrichment

```{r}
if (file.exists(tab("enrichment_summary.tsv"))) {
  knitr::kable(rd("enrichment_summary.tsv"), caption = "Number of significant terms per analysis")
}
```

```{r, out.width = "80%"}
show_fig("Fig10E_GSEA_Hallmark")
show_fig("Fig10A_Hallmark_UP")
show_fig("Fig10B_Hallmark_DOWN")
```

# Software

Per-step `sessionInfo()` output is written to `results/logs/`.

```{r}
cat(paste(utils::capture.output(utils::sessionInfo()), collapse = "\n"))
```
